description: List the posts not yet sent (this project, or every project with all=true): stage 'draft' = being worked on, 'review' = complete and dated, waiting for an owner or admin. Each carries stage, body, media, targets, scheduled_at, overrides, card_id, submitted_via (api = from an agent), design, lang, translated_from_id, assigned_to and assigned_to_name (the member it is assigned to), review {score, verdict, reviewed_at, entries[]}, needs_review (no verdict on its current content), valid_verdict, content_hash and updated_at.

all.description: true = every project of the organization.

assigned_to.description: Only the posts assigned to this member (a user id from viralhunt_members).

needs_review.description: true = only posts with no verdict on their current content (the reviewer's queue).

project.description: Project name (default: the org's first project).

name: viralhunt_drafts
